r: I told you.. Ughh.. I told you..
It hurts.. oh God it hurts..
I owe you.. Ahh.. I'm going..
Easy.. easy.. I'm here, don't move
Stay with me! Look at me!
Quit squirming, let me see it
Damn it.. how bad is it?
Nobody.. it's only me.. Ahh.. please..
Kimse yok.. ben tek başımayım.. Ahh.. lütfen..
Far.. Ahh.. far from here.. help me..
Uzakta.. Ahh.. buradan uzakta.. bana yardım et..

Silahlı biri.. kim olduğunu görmedim.. Iıh..

Don't you even think about raising that
